notes: cics-crucible pseudo-conversational / pc-aid-menu (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): the detail screen PCDETL, entered as a LINKed program ("linked": true) because its PIC X(10) DFHCOMMAREA has no generated COMMAREA DTO for a top-level entry. Both arms: EIBCALEN 0, and EIBCALEN 10 with the typed WS-CA record (the Object-service DTO fallback, #7422). The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not z/OS.

scenarios.name: no-context
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: SEND TEXT NO CONTEXT, RETURN

scenarios.name: with-context
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 10: the detail screen shows the menu COMMAREA and EIBTRNID

scenarios.name: short-calen-3-hex
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 3, shorter than the 10-byte layout: the area is cut to the caller's length

scenarios.name: calen-1-hex
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 1: one byte of the area

scenarios.name: long-calen-20
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 19, longer than the 10-byte DFHCOMMAREA: only the first 10 bytes are read

scenarios.name: sendmap-invreq
scenarios.why: SEND MAP answers INVREQ: no RESP, condition() abend path

scenarios.name: sendtext-invreq
scenarios.why: SEND TEXT answers INVREQ on the no-context arm

scenarios.name: sendmap-invmpsz
scenarios.why: SEND MAP answers INVMPSZ, whose RESP2 IBM states none: the abend path with EIBRESP2 0

scenarios.name: sendmap-tsioerr
scenarios.why: SEND MAP answers TSIOERR with RESP2 0

scenarios.name: sendtext-tsioerr
scenarios.why: SEND TEXT answers TSIOERR with RESP2 0 on the no-context arm

scenarios.name: sendtext-lengerr
scenarios.why: SEND TEXT answers LENGERR with RESP2 0

scenarios.name: calen-10-exact
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 10 as raw bytes: exactly the area
